name: sentinels-gambit
description: Research demo by Sentinel Sage: score 10 network-flow features with XGBoost + IsolationForest → class + action. Session-isolated demo console with ephemeral retrain. Not a production IDS.

paragraphs: Score 10 engineered network-flow features → attack class + recommended action (Block / Alert / Quarantine / Log), with session-scoped demo data, live monitoring, and ephemeral retrain.

Responsible use: Sentinel's Gambit is a research / portfolio demo. It is not a production intrusion detection system or SOC. Respond / playbook actions are simulated. Do not use demo output for real security decisions.
There is no third-party labelled traffic corpus distributed or cited as the training set. Do not treat outputs as evaluated against a public IDS benchmark.
features: Scenario-first Dashboard (Flood / Port Sweep / Burst / Benign) + advanced 10-field form.
Dual scores: malicious confidence + class confidence + action rationale; GET /api/scoring-policy/ + How scoring works panel.
Real-Time Monitoring: event stream, 15-minute activity histogram, action mix.
Incident Response: playbook vs workflow chips, mock playbook drawer, session delete/clear (simulated respond).
Adaptive Learning: plain-language ephemeral retrain (before→after, sample mix, collapsible details); serving weights unchanged unless DEMOPERSISTRETRAIN=true.

whatItDoes.text: Score 10 engineered network-flow features → attack class + recommended action (Block / Alert / Quarantine / Log), with session-scoped demo data, live monitoring, and ephemeral retrain.

requirements.text: No account required for the hosted demo.
